content: Medicare provides reimbursement for Diabetes Self-Management Education and Support (DSMES) services when specific criteria are met. This coverage includes both in-person and virtual services, with the scope of virtual services having been expanded during the COVID-19 pandemic. Medicaid and private insurers are also encouraged to offer reimbursement for DSMES participation, particularly when these services are delivered via telehealth. This approach aims to improve access for underserved populations who may face barriers to traditional in-person care. Recent policy updates emphasize a strong commitment to increasing the accessibility of DSMES services across various healthcare settings, ensuring that individuals with diabetes receive the necessary education and support to manage their condition effectively.
